note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content. The transcript and DDx JSON you provided appear as placeholders ({transcript} and {ddx}). Please supply:

- The full physician–patient transcript (text of the encounter).
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) as a JSON list or equivalent.

What I will produce once I have them:

- A structured SOAP note with the exact headings and bullet-style format you specified.
- Subjective: current issues, history of present illness, past medical history, medications, social history, allergies (as applicable).
- Objective: physical examination findings (with sides, sites, and details) and any investigations/results (if provided).
- Assessment & Plan: for each issue/problem, including:
  - Issue name (one per section)
  - Likely diagnosis
  - Consistent differential diagnoses drawn from the provided DDx (and note if any conflict)
  - Investigations planned (if any)
  - Treatments planned (if any)
  - Referrals (if any)
- Quality checks: any missing elements, conflicts between transcript and DDx (flag with “conflict noted”), and notes on transcript quality if relevant.

Guidelines I will follow:
- Use American English, concise and professional.
- Do not introduce information not present in the transcript or DDx.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If transcript and DDx conflict, I will present both and mark “conflict noted.”

Please provide the actual transcript and the DDx content, and I will generate the complete note.
